system.description:
Beginning at 9th level, you have a unique ability to demoralize enemies or instill a since of ego in your allies have strengthened. When you use a Trickster Maneuver on a creature, you may as a part of the same action, use another maneuver targeting the same creature by using another superiority die.

Additionally, all ability modifiers that your Void Soul has is increased by +1.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
